visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a view of a modern Japanese-style twin bedroom featuring wooden flooring, two beds with navy blue headboards, and a traditional shoji-style sliding screen with a blue mountain graphic. (2) The scene cuts to a large, dimly lit communal bath area with stone walls and a calm water surface reflecting the overhead warm lights. (3) A close-up shot displays a breakfast plate featuring toast with bacon and two fried eggs, accompanied by small dishes of salad, fruit, and coffee. (4) The camera shows a minimalist hotel lobby with large natural stone blocks used as benches and a dark wooden reception counter. (5) In the hotel room, the focus shifts to a wall-mounted TV on a light wood panel and a corner with a small refrigerator and desk. (6) A hand is seen reaching for a white hair dryer on a bright vanity counter with multiple sinks and large mirrors. (7) The camera captures a hand opening a drawer and selecting a light blue popsicle from a selection of frozen treats. (8) A close-up of the breakfast shows a fork breaking the yolk of a fried egg over toasted bread. (9) An outdoor shot shows several mint-green rental bicycles parked in front of the hotel entrance under a bright sky. (10) The final scene displays a cozy Japanese-style sitting area with a low wooden table and two chairs in a warm, brightly lit room.
